Leaders Discuss Education Reform and National Development

Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has advocated for an education system that prepares students for the future, moving beyond a sole focus on examinations. Separately, a seer has called for a uniform education policy and the implementation of a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) alongside judicial reforms as essential steps towards building a developed India.
